newsitem.title: USA: Barney's sees at least three potential investors.
newsitem.headline: Barney's sees at least three potential investors.

text.p: Barney's Inc said it is negotiating with Dickson Concepts Ltd and at least two other potential parties regarding an investment.
The upscale retailer has been operating in bankruptcy since last January.

The interest has prompted Barney's to ask the U.S. bankruptcy court to extend its exclusive right to file a reorganization plan until June 3. The exclusivity period had been set to expire on February 3.
A spokeswoman for Barney's said the court is expected to rule on the request on January 23.
In November, Barney's said it had reached an agreement with Dickson under which the Asian retailer would submit a definitive proposal to participate in a recapitalization of Barneys.
Barney's said Friday that Dickson will submit its proposal by February 15. A spokeswoman declined to name the other interested parties.
